home.title: Free Online Sailing Simulator & Game | VibeSail
home.tagline: Play VibeSail: a free online 3D sailing simulator, sailing game, and sailboat simulator. No download. Daily races, cities, and sail-trim tutorial in your browser.
home.h1: Free online sailboat simulator: a 3D sailing game in your browser

seo.physics_body: Wind angle, sail trim, heel, and boat response all matter: a sailboat simulator that practices the same fundamentals used on the water.
seo.modes_body: Explore Free Sail, join the Daily Race, sail with live multiplayer boats, or push farther in High Sea.
seo.tutorial_body: New to sailing? The guided tutorial teaches steering, sail trim, and getting underway before you race.
seo.platforms_body: No install. Play on desktop or mobile with keyboard, touch, or gamepad.
seo.faq_free_a: Yes. VibeSail is a free online sailing simulator: open your browser, set sail, and play at no cost.
seo.faq_install_q: Do I need to download or install anything?
seo.faq_install_a: No. VibeSail is an online sailing game that runs in your browser. Visit vibesail.com and play with no download.
seo.faq_devices_a: Yes. VibeSail supports desktop, mobile browsers, and gamepads.
seo.faq_learn_q: How do I learn the controls?
seo.faq_learn_a: Start with the interactive tutorial, then practice sail trim and tacking in Free Sail.
seo.simulator_title: A free sailing simulator in your browser
seo.simulator_body: VibeSail is a free sailing simulator and boat simulator with no download. Sail in the browser on desktop or mobile: wind angle, sail trim, and steering. Whether you call it a sail simulator, sailboat simulator, or boat simulator, it is the same browser experience: no install.
seo.yacht_body: Looking for a yacht simulator? You helm a sailboat: wind, course, and sail trim, not a motor yacht. It is also a free sailing game. If you are browsing sailing games, this one runs in the browser, with races and a tutorial, instead of a store install.
seo.compare_title: Compared with download sims and race apps
seo.compare_body: Many sailing simulators are desktop installs built for long passages. Virtual Regatta-style race apps focus on fleet tactics for a scheduled regatta. VibeSail is the free browser option: a sailboat simulator you can open immediately, with a daily race, cities and harbors, and other boats on the water. It is lighter than a full ocean-navigation suite, and it is not a season-long regatta manager.
seo.faq_sim_q: Is VibeSail a sailing simulator or a boat simulator?
seo.faq_sim_a: Both. You sail in the browser with wind, trim, and steering, and there is no download. Whether you call it a sail simulator or sailboat simulator, it is the same boat and the same physics.
seo.faq_yacht_q: Is there a yacht simulator or a sailing game?
seo.faq_yacht_a: You helm a sailboat, which is the yacht-simulator experience: wind and sail trim, not a motor yacht. It is a free sailing game. If you are looking through sailing games, this one plays online in the browser.
seo.faq_compare_q: How is this different from a download sailing simulator or a Virtual Regatta-style app?
seo.faq_compare_a: Download sailing simulators usually install a large offshore world. Virtual Regatta-style apps are built around fleet tactics for a scheduled race. VibeSail is a free browser sailing simulator with a daily race, harbors, and other boats on the water. It is lighter than a passage sim, and it is not a season-long regatta manager.
